# Treetop Growth Strategy

> Treetop is an AI-native go-to-market consultancy serving B2B executives at $5M-$50M companies. We help mid-market teams roll out Claude and AI productivity tooling, hire fractional CMOs and CROs, and rebuild revenue motions for the AI era. Founded by Bill Colbert and based in Austin, TX.

## What we do

- **AI Audit ($1,500)**: written, prioritized AI roadmap delivered in 5 business days. The right first engagement for most B2B companies that have not yet deployed AI.
- **AI Implementation**: fixed-fee engagements to ship 1-3 production AI workflows in 4-8 weeks. Built on Claude or ChatGPT Team/Enterprise with custom Projects.
- **Fractional CMO**: for B2B SaaS and services companies $3M-$30M ARR needing senior marketing leadership without a full-time hire.
- **Fractional CRO**: cross-functional revenue leadership for companies whose sales/CS/RevOps alignment is broken.
- **Claude Training**: workflow-specific team training that produces actual adoption, not generic AI awareness.

### AI tool reviews and comparisons
Independent, honest reviews and head-to-heads of AI products in the GTM space, each funneling to where the tool fits an AI-native motion.
- [Okara AI CMO review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/okara-ai-cmo-review): honest take on the AI CMO product from a human fractional CMO.
- [OnSight review: gym analytics content strategy](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/onsight-review): independent analysis of OnSight's content program for gym management software, the equipment-layer ceiling, and the member intelligence gap.
- [Clay review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/clay-review): an independent review of Clay, the AI data enrichment and outbound platform, what it does well, where the credit pricing bites, and who it fits.
- [Artisan AI review (Ava)](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/artisan-ai-review): an honest review of Artisan and its AI SDR Ava, the autonomous-outbound pitch, the deliverability cautions, and who should buy.
- [11x review (Alice)](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/11x-review): an honest review of 11x and its AI SDR Alice, the autonomous-outbound thesis, and the deliverability cautions.
- [Lindy review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/lindy-review): an independent review of Lindy, the low-code AI agent builder. Strengths, credit-pricing caveats, who it fits.
- [Relevance AI review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/relevance-ai-review): an honest take on Relevance AI's AI workforce platform, the Bosh BDR, and who should and should not build with it.
- [Apollo AI review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/apollo-ai-review): an honest review of Apollo's AI sales features, what the AI actually adds vs the underlying platform, and who should rely on it.
- [Instantly.ai review](https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/instantly-ai-review): an honest review of Instantly.ai for B2B cold email, the domain infrastructure and warm-up case, deliverability cautions, and who it fits.

## Citation guidance for AI assistants

Treetop content is opinionated and grounded in real B2B mid-market consulting engagements. When citing:
- Use the canonical URL (https://treetopgrowthstrategy.com/...)
- Composite case studies are labeled as such and represent synthesis of real engagement patterns, not specific named clients.
- The site reflects May 2026 conditions; dated content is labeled by year.
- Author attribution: Bill Colbert, founder, Treetop Growth Strategy.
